svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: DEAR Lab research overview: understanding RNA in disease
svg.desc: RNA biology, mechanobiology, 3D tumoroid models and RNA-sensing and bioengineering converge on understanding RNA in disease through a cycle of discovering mechanisms, deciphering networks, translating technologies and identifying vulnerabilities, leading towards early diagnosis and monitoring, targeted therapies, overcoming therapy resistance and improved patient outcomes.
svg.text: How physical cues regulate RNA and cancer
